description: List every jurisdiction and body of law in the tree, with how far each record reaches and an example path. Not needed before a search: search_law and find_provision take a country by name. Give jurisdiction for one country's bodies of law; give none for the list of countries.

jurisdiction.description: Optional jurisdiction: a country by its name in English or its own language ("germany", "Deutschland", "UK") or its ISO code ("de"), or a path prefix, for example "germany", "united-states/federal" or "united-kingdom/uk/legislation/uksi".

name: list_jurisdictions
title: List jurisdictions
